text_md:
To  summarize,  the  conclusion  of  current  research  is showing  that  consuming  3mg/kg  caffeine,  1.5  g  Lcarnitine    and  their  combination  has  no  meaningful effect on performance . More researches are necessary in  order  to  investigate  the  acute  effects  of  different amount  of  caffeine    and    L-carnitine  on  400-m freestyle  performance  time  and  the  blood  lactate level.

## Acknowledgement

This  research  was  supported  by  a  grant  from  Karaj Branch,  Islamic  Azad  University.  The  authors  would like  to  thank  Dr  mehdi  hedayati    for  his    technical assistance.  We  express  our  gratitude  to  the  staff  of Biochemistry Laboratory at Endocrine Research Center of Shahid Beheshti University for their skillful technical assistance.
